Hero.description:
Finishing my CS degree at Federico II, after a year of backend work at IdeaSolutions and the Apple Developer Academy. Right now I'm the sole engineer and co-founder at Clinequal — a startup where I translate domain theory from my PhD co-founders into software that flags bias in clinical trials.
Building alone has forced me to make every architectural decision myself: what to build, what to cut, how to keep things simple enough to actually ship. I like that pressure, but I also want to work alongside people who are better than me.
Outside of code, I'm a photographer, a Tango dancer, and a Jazz/Prog-Rock lover. Based in Naples, Italy.

items.name: CLINEQUAL
items.description: Clinical trial bias analysis platform. 15+ statistical tests, LLM-powered SDTM detection, GDPR/HIPAA compliant multi-tenant architecture. Supporting a €400K pre-seed round.

items.name: IULY
items.description: Cross-platform playlist converter between Apple Music and Spotify using ISRC matching. Strategy pattern for extensible provider support.

items.name: BEEZZZ
items.description: ESP32 IoT bee hive monitoring with real-time mic and accelerometer data via MQTT. I2S/I2C sensors, plus a companion iOS app.

items.name: ISWING
items.description: An iOS app built with SwiftUI exploring motion and interaction patterns.

items.name: TERMINAL TEXT EDITOR
items.description: A terminal-based text editor written from scratch in C. Raw mode terminal handling, syntax highlighting, and file I/O.

items.name: CONTAINER C++ LIBRARY
items.description: A generic container library implementing core data structures with iterators, following STL conventions.

highlights.title: Health-tech platform
highlights.description: Architected a regulatory-ready (FDA/EMA) health-tech platform using Python/FastAPI, supporting a €400K pre-seed round and multi-tenant B2B pilots.

highlights.title: Ingestion pipeline
highlights.description: Built an AI-powered ingestion pipeline utilizing a local LLM (Phi-3) to map clinical data to CDISC SDTM standards with strict PHI privacy.

highlights.title: Statistical engine
highlights.description: Developed a plugin-based statistical engine with 15+ bias tests paired with an XAI layer for regulatory-aligned narratives.

highlights.title: Stockholm networking
highlights.description: Represented the company at Tech Arena Stockholm, translating complex AI architecture to VC funds and investment banks.

highlights.title: SuperGuidaTV contribution
highlights.description: Contributed to SuperGuidaTV (500,000+ monthly active users), integrating core features like user watchlists.

highlights.title: Scoped works

highlights.title: Logging system
